runs.text: Now a new way of paying has to be added, with its own surcharge. In which version is less touched?
A payment method is a new kind of thing that shares a contract: it is the change objects make easy.

justification.text: A new class that meets the payment methods contract; the till does not change.
A new function is enough, but every place that chooses the method needs to know it.
Each decision about the payment method needs one more case.
